title: Roy Eldridge, Shad Collins and staying in your own age
summary: Roy Eldridge and Shad Collins came from his sphere; Butler argues that a man shouldn't try to modernise himself like the young or he will harm his health.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant
